protocol.timings: Same loopSource as Oseo study: 3 fresh processes, 2 warmup + 5 measured batches, adaptive calls/batch; hello 3 warmup + 15 spawn-to-exit samples. Serial, round 2 reverse order; medians of process medians.
protocol.controls: Oseo and Node artifacts reused and measured in this pass, previous timings preserved. Oseo O2/no-sanitizers controls measured afterwards separately. Standard production compiler settings, not normalized optimizer/sanitizer flags.
protocol.semantics: Object timings skipped if minimal alias probe prints 0 instead of 9. All successful workload checksums validated; finite probes are not whole-language conformance.
protocol.wrapper: Oseo and JS inputs use untyped durations; scriptc TS requires number[] for its measurement array. Workload annotations preserved.
protocol.clock: Date.now 1ms resolution except hello hrtime; interactive host without thermal or frequency control. Current battery/low-power settings captured; not a causal explanation of older timings.
protocol.provenance: Original inputs saved below, retained C/IR paths and binary/source hashes per result. Native CLI versions from actual executables. Source artifacts are unoptimized IR unless tool says otherwise.
